method: per-side landmark identification then independent interior-angle computation; the two knee landmarks are verified distinct before use
tolerance: exact to 4 dp against the diagnostic source; no tolerance band needed
swap_test: a LEFT/RIGHT label swap would report LEFT min 140.008 and RIGHT min 147.231; the regression test asserts LEFT=147.2307@f126 and RIGHT=140.0076@f101, so a swap fails it
verdict: VALIDATED — the engine distinguishes the two physical knees, and the per-frame minimum alternates sides, which is exactly why a per-frame minimum can never be read as a left or right value
